answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a reputation system anchored by a unique, costly-to-forge digital identity, akin to a sable signature. Each agent's identity serves as a lantern, broadcasting its transaction history and reputation. To create a Sybil identity, an attacker must expend resources to craft a quill-written, digitally-signed credential, which costs proportionally to the desired reputation level, thereby deterring attackers.
